_about: One scorecard for the competitors' live ads (Meta Ad Library, India, 2-4 Nov 2026), Naira's recent ads (Meta, last 14 days) and each new set. Ten criteria, 0-10 each, weighted; score = weighted mean. Judged by eye on the full-size creative, the same way for every ad.

criteria.stop: Thumb-stop at phone size: contrast, one focal point, something to look at in 0.5 s.
criteria.truth: Product truth and scale: you can read what the piece is and how big it is on a body.
criteria.craft: Photo craft: light, metal and stone rendering, skin, set; nothing that reads as CGI.
criteria.desire: Desire and occasion: styling and mood that make you want to wear it, a moment to wear it to.
criteria.hierarchy: One message at a time, every word readable on a 390pt-wide phone.
criteria.offer: Price and the reason to buy now are in the image, or deliberately left to the caption.
criteria.brand: Wordmark and palette identify the brand without shouting.
criteria.series: The ad belongs to a system that runs as a carousel and a campaign.
criteria.platform: 4:5 and 9:16 versions, type inside the safe zones, text kept small in area.
criteria.compliance: Every claim true for the piece and the checkout today; none of Naira's banned words.

benchmark.what: on-model espresso studio crop, '9KT Pendant Free' serif offer, outlined Shop now
same carousel, product card: name only
'A hot cup of silver, anyone?' chain poured like tea, hands, two-line serif
catalogue packshot on grey, price in the card title
catalogue packshot on white, code BLING in the caption

naira_recent.ad: DIW 08 · Nobody got the better pair.

naira_recent.flag: caption still says 20% / 30% off; checkout gives 10% / 20%

judge._about: An independent judge (a separate agent that saw only the images and the rubric, never these scores) scored every ad by eye. Round 1: Sets 1-2 as first built; the fixes listed in the README followed. Round 2 (all 20) is added when it is in.

ads.best: Real editorial shoot of a coordinated heart set at true dainty scale, warm light, and one clear serif offer line.
ads.fix: Show a 'from ₹' price beside the free-pendant offer so the ₹20,000 threshold has an entry point.

ads.best: Tight on-skin crop makes the pendant's real size, setting and sparkle unmistakable.
ads.fix: Repeat the price or the free-pendant offer so the card sells when seen on its own.

ads.best: A witty, instantly legible concept (silver poured from a teapot) with one clean headline.
ads.fix: Add a price or offer line: it stops the thumb but gives no reason to buy now.

ads.best: Clean, accurate packshot with good gold rendering and readable chain detail.
ads.fix: Put it on a hand: no scale, mood, wordmark or price in the frame.

ads.best: The inset zoom honestly shows the link construction.
ads.fix: Shoot it on a neck against a darker ground; a fine silver line on white vanishes at phone size.

ads.best: Pomegranate seeds rhyme with the ruby-tone baguettes: a rich, well-lit thumb-stop.
ads.fix: Add wordmark, name, price and the bundle chip inside the Story safe zone; right now it sells nothing.

ads.best: Pastel powder rainbow echoes the stone colours; playful and on-palette.
ads.fix: Show it on an ear with name and price; off-body it is unclear what the piece is or how big it is.

ads.best: Juicy apricot and peach linen make the woven texture tactile; quiet, confident type.
ads.fix: The ₹1,499 is ~8pt: set the price at 10pt or more and add the bundle offer as the reason to buy.

ads.best: The gold heart is a clean single focal point on blush satin, with an elegant headline.
ads.fix: Add the NAIRA wordmark and an on-wrist frame; the macro makes the beads read bigger than life.

ads.best: Four jewel-tone potlis form a bold, giftable colour block with a witty line.
ads.fix: The info line (price included) is ~7pt: enlarge it and add a 'buy 2' gifting incentive.

ads.best: Kesar strands and ruby-tone stones make a culturally sharp still life with a strong line.
ads.fix: Say 'Ruby-tone' and show it on a finger: the band reads chunky and 'RUBY' reads like the real stone.

ads.best: Candy-and-CZ concept with a big, readable headline and an honest 'cubic zirconia, not candy'.
ads.fix: Drop 'Anti-tarnish / Surgical steel', add the wordmark, and cut five type elements to two.

ads.best: Graphic pastel stripes make a bold, on-palette Story composition.
ads.fix: Remove the baked-in SHOP NOW that sits on the Shop-button zone, and add name and price.

ads.best: The pheni-to-mesh texture rhyme is clever and beautifully crafted.
ads.fix: Beige-on-beige is a weak stop: add a contrasting ground or an on-wrist shot, and lift the ~8pt price line.

ads.best: Ruby-red baguettes against deep brown skin and backdrop: the strongest stop in Set 1, with a clean price-plus-bundle card.
ads.fix: Render the stones at their true 6x3mm: the collar reads about 1.5x too chunky, close to costume (and say 'Ruby-tone').

ads.best: Believable profile with crisp woven texture on the lobe and a clean four-line card.
ads.fix: Bring the hoop back to its true 25mm (it reads ~33mm tall) and soften the brassy yellow toward the product's real gold.

ads.best: Pastel halo links pop vividly against warm skin and the dark ground.
ads.fix: Reshoot the pose: the crossed arms don't resolve (the lower hand has no plausible owner); use one wrist, one hand.

ads.best: Hand-at-lips beauty pose with one bright sparkle; 'Adjustable, fits US 5 to 9' removes the sizing objection.
ads.fix: Scale the head to ~12mm: it currently spans nearly the full finger width and reads as a bigger cocktail ring.

ads.best: Most honest scale and styling in Set 1: paperclip chain and clasp on a white shirt, wearable and believable.
ads.fix: Add contrast or crop tighter on the clasp; thin gold over white shirt and skin is the weakest stop in the set.

ads.best: Mehendi hand on haldi-yellow silk with an emerald-tone band: bold colour, an explicit occasion, a witty line, true scale.
ads.fix: Lift the Story text block ~40px (the chip runs 39px into the Shop-button zone) and restore the wordmark in the Story.

ads.best: The most photographic ad here: gajra, a real ear, a true-size 15mm huggie and a sharp occasion line.
ads.fix: Make the huggie win the first glance (tighter crop or brighter sparkle); at phone size the gajra out-stops the product.

ads.best: Gift box plus 'tying the knot' gives a clear gifting occasion; the bangle reads at true scale.
ads.fix: Add contrast: bring the deep red silk into the Feed frame; the cream/pink palette is a soft thumb-stop.

ads.best: Sangeet styling (blush kurta, gota-edged dupatta) makes the layering set feel wearable; chains and marquise at true scale.
ads.fix: Cut the six-line stack to four, lift the Story chip ~80px out of the Shop zone, and fix the goosebump skin texture.

ads.best: Green stone pops on the ear at true 16.8mm scale; believable skin, hair and bobby-pin detail.
ads.fix: Show the Banarasi in the Feed: the headline promises a match the frame barely shows.

set_notes.set1: A tight, recognisable system (chocolate backdrop, beauty crop, centred card with price + bundle chip) that is more sellable than any recent Naira ad or the competitor catalogue tiles, but about one point below PAL-9KT-hero: no idea or occasion, inflated scale on the necklace and ring, one anatomically broken pose (S1_03), and a dark palette that drifts from Naira's cream/blush identity.
set_notes.set2: The stronger set and the closest to the benchmark: wedding-season moments (mehendi, gajra, gift, sangeet, Banarasi) give every ad an occasion and a line, pieces sit at true spec scale, and craft is the most photographic yet (S2_06/S2_07 approach PAL-9KT-hero). It loses points on soft low-contrast stops (S2_08, S2_09), an overloaded stack on S2_09, and Story cuts that drop the wordmark/headline and push the chip into the Shop zone (S2_06 +39px, S2_09 +79px).

round1.lessons: 1) Keep Set 2's formula: one Indian occasion, one witty line, the piece at true spec scale, price plus the bundle chip; it beat Set 1 on desire, truth and craft. 2) Scale-check every frame against the product page (6x3mm stones, ~12mm ring head, 25mm hoop) using the ear, finger or neck as a ruler; reject any frame where the piece reads more than ~1.2x real size. 3) Engineer the stop: put one saturated colour field (haldi yellow, white gajra on black hair, deep red silk) behind the piece; avoid pink-on-pink and cream-on-cream. 4) Cap the type at four lines (headline, name, price, chip) at 10pt or more, and move sublines like 'Two necklaces, worn as one' to the caption. 5) Build Stories from a template, not a re-crop: keep the wordmark and headline, keep every element between y=270 and ~y=1500, and run an anatomy pass (count hands, trace each arm) on every model shot.
